Name: 50 Pack Mini Pk Silver 10 Stretch Loops 1/16 Round
Natural: Stretch cord loops with pre-tied bow make gift giving easy! Stretch Loops with pre-tied bow in metallic gold or silver, red & black. Stretch loops are made from a 1/16" stretch tie cord which is elastic with a metalized polypropylene coating. The 6" & 8" loops fit most of our jewelry boxes and give them that final touch. The 10" is great for smaller apparel, stationery & gift boxes. The 16" and 19" loop fits larger boxes such as our apparel boxes. Just wrap it around your package and you're finished!
